Now, the brand has posted a short video clip on X, teasing the launch of the X Fold6 in India on October 6. The teaser shows the vivo X Fold6 in Nebula Teal, but there could be more color options that are yet to be confirmed. title: Huawei Watch GT 7 Pro review
description: Huawei’s Watch GT series has consistently offered a blend of premium build quality, extensive health and activity tracking, and top-tier battery endurance, and the Watch GT 7 Pro takes that same formula while overhauling the sports tracking experience. Despite its new colors and a revised watch strap system, the Watch GT 7 Pro is mostly unchanged from its predecessor on the hardware front. With this iteration, Huawei focused on expanding the number of sports tracking features for cycling, skiing and golf. Huawei is also touting an overhauled positioning algorithm with over 50%...

title: Deals: Early Prime Day deals on Samsung foldables now live, Pixel 11 Pro and Galaxy S26 Ultra discounted
description: Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days sale begins on October 6, but the e-commerce giant is already offering early deals on select devices. However, you’ll need an Amazon Prime membership to take advantage of the discounts. The latest Galaxy Z foldables and the Galaxy S26 Ultra are also available at reduced prices. The Google Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro aren’t technically on sale, but Amazon is offering bundle deals that include a free pair of Pixel Buds Pro 2. title: Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max runs Geekbench, revealing Kirin 9050 Pro performance
description: Huawei launched four new Mate 90 series phones in China yesterday and the more capable Pro Max and RS models feature the brand’s latest Kirin 9050 Pro chipset. While Huawei did not reveal much about the SoC in its marketing materials, a fresh Geekbench test run for the Mate 90 Pro Max has us covered. Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max on Geekbench 7 The Mate 90 Pro Max (CMM-AL10) scored an average of 1,317 single-core points and 5,381 multi-core points on Geekbench 7. description: Price hikes are the name of the game these days in the mobile world, thanks to memory and storage chips costing many times more than a few years ago because of AI data center demand. Even knowing all that, today's leaked European prices for the Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max are still rather shocking. The caveat here is obvious - this is a rumor. Hopefully a wrong one. Anyway, according to a new report, the Find X10 will cost €1,399 with 256GB of storage and €1,599 with 512GB, while the Find X10 Pro Max will be offered in a single version with 512GB of storage for €1,799. title: Here's when Honor's wide foldable is now rumored to launch
description: If you trust rumors, Honor has been working on a wide foldable of its own for quite some time now. Last we heard anything about it, it was apparently supposed to be launching by the end of this year. However, according to a new rumor from a well-known leaker on Weibo, that won't quite happen. Instead, Honor will allegedly be launching its wide foldable in January. Intriguingly, it is said to arrive with a "very rich" accessory ecosystem, meaning that Honor is treating it as a very important product, not just a one-off experiment. title: Samsung Display to start mass AMOLED production for the Galaxy S27 series
description: Earlier today we reported on the fact that Samsung has apparently started mass producing the Exynos 2700 chipset which will be used in its upcoming Galaxy S27 series. But that's not all. According to a separate report from Korea, Samsung Display is preparing to start mass production of the AMOLED panels for the Galaxy S27 family this month. As rumored countless times before, there will be four members in this lineup: the 6.27-inch Galaxy S27, the 6.66-inch Galaxy S27+, the 6.47-inch Galaxy S27 Pro, and the 6.89-inch Galaxy S27 Ultra. description: Not satisfied with having one laptop platform, Google introduced Googlebooks – Android-powered laptops. The official page for the platform lists laptops from Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo. Now it appears that Samsung will be joining the party soon with a Googlebook of its own. title: Samsung starts mass producing Exynos 2700 chip, Galaxy S27 Ultra decision still up in the air
description: Samsung has begun mass production of the Exynos 2700 chipset, according to Korean publication The Elec. The company has reportedly set the production target “more than 10% higher” than the Exynos 2600 target to account for the new addition to the S-series family – the Galaxy S27 Pro. The Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro – along with the vanilla and plus models – will use the Exynos 2700 in Korea and Europe. These models will switch to a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip for the US and China. As for the Galaxy S27 Ultra, that one is still up in the air. Samsung System LSI, which designs the Exynos...

title: AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile officially launch joint venture to end dead zones
description: Back in May, AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile announced "an agreement in principle" to create a joint venture that would strive to end dead zones across the US. Today, almost five months later, that joint venture has finally been officially launched. Paul Roth will serve as interim CEO of the new company while an active search is underway for a permanent CEO. Roth previously held several leadership positions at AT&T, Cingular Wireless, and Ameritech. The joint venture will be managed by a board of representatives from each of the three carriers. description: So, you're eyeing a new Samsung flagship and, if money is no object, the new Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra might be on your shortlist. Then again, perhaps you're not entirely convinced that you actually need a foldable in your life. Wouldn't the simpler, more conventional Galaxy S26 Ultra make more sense? Granted, this is a fairly specific dilemma and probably not an especially common one. Still, let's put the two side by side and see where each one has the upper hand. description: We've always enjoyed Apple's Shot on iPhone media stunts. It's the popular "give a professional a tool and get professional results" method, and it always works. A true pro in his field will always get amazing results, even with a phone. In this case, Apple gave the iPhone Duo to two photographers - Jake Michaels, who contributed one of the photos, and Jason Nocito. description: Today Nothing has opened up submissions for a new Community Review Program. The company describes this as "your chance to get hands-on" with its latest products and software before anyone else, "and to show off your creativity by sharing your own take with a vibrant global community". title: Amazon unveils its updated Kindle lineup
description: Amazon announced three new Kindles today, which bring updated colors, thinner and lighter profiles and longer-lasting batteries. All versions now come with flush displays and optional aluminum backs. The basic Kindle (12th generation) features the same-sized 6-inch e-ink screen but with more rounded corners and a seamless flush display. This allowed Amazon to expand the color options, with the borders around the display getting the same hues as the rest of the device. Amazon Kindle 12th gen Ube is the new hero color. title: iPhone Duo's inner display protector is replaceable, here's how much it costs
description: According to Apple's service and repair website, the iPhone Duo's top layer of the foldable screen can be replaced. And it's quite cheap if you have AppleCare. Apple says the matte screen cover on top of the main display can be replaced for just $19.99 if you have active AppleCare. You just need to visit one of Apple's Service Providers. AppleCare also includes a $29 cover display or back glass repairs and $99 inner display replacement. Accidental damage is $99, while theft and loss protection will cost you $149. title: Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max will let you use three SIMs simultaneously
description: Ever wished you could use three SIMs simultaneously on your phone? You can do just that with Huawei’s latest flagship phone, the Mate 90 Pro Max. Huawei launched the phone in China alongside the rest of the Mate 90 series, which includes the Mate 90, Mate 90 Pro, and Mate 90 RS. An X user has highlighted the feature, which is also confirmed on Huawei’s official specifications page for the Mate 90 Pro Max. title: Samsung updates SmartThings app with redesigned Home tab
description: Samsung is doing a major overhaul of its SmartThings app with version 1.8.51.30. This update redesigns the Home tab and updates the Devices tab. This version already rolled out to iOS (actually, iPhone users got it first) and is now available on the Google Play Store and the Galaxy Store. The Home tab now features more compact cards for devices and routines. You can tap on their icon to turn a device on or off or to trigger a routine. Cards can be resized and rearranged as needed. title: Apple's HomePad / Home Hub may come in these four colors
description: Yesterday a report told us that Apple is going to finally unveil its much-rumored Home Hub or HomePad on October 13. That report implied that it would only be available in one color, described as "Apple's standard gray aluminum finish". However, it turns out that the device could actually be offered in four colors: Silver, Space Gray, Starlight, and Rose Pink. This information comes from a tipster on X who uncovered the Photo Face setup screens, which will allegedly correspond to the four colors of the Home Hub / HomePad itself. title: Here's when Samsung's first Android XR glasses are finally launching
description: Samsung showcased its first Android XR glasses during its Galaxy Unpacked event in July, and now a new report from its home country of South Korea tells us when we should expect them to finally launch: in November. This has allegedly been confirmed by "a Samsung official". Pricing still isn't known, unfortunately. The glasses will apparently be called Intelligent Eyewear. They have no display, but do come with a camera, microphones, and speakers. Google's Gemini AI processes the information that you see and hear through a connected Galaxy smartphone.
